item5_02.keyComponents: Jill Windrum was appointed as the Company's Chief Accounting Officer and Deputy Chief Financial Officer, effective August 31, 2026. She will replace Brian LaRose as the principal accounting officer.

academicAffiliations: Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Accounting from James Madison University

Previously held various finance and accounting leadership roles at Vantor, formerly known as Maxar Technologies Inc., from October 2013 to June 2025, and various roles in audit, advisory and KPMG's national office from October 2002 to September 2013.
